# Tailoring Recipes

<!-- This page is generated by tools/professions/build.py from tools/professions/recipes/tailoring.json. -->

This page lists all 417 Tailoring recipes in the game client, build 1.60.1.70862. The headings are the headings of the in-game window. For the path from 1 to 300 and the recipe picks, see the [Tailoring guide](tailoring.md).

**Learn** is the skill that the client gives for the recipe. A dash shows a trainer recipe, because the client does not hold that skill. **Yellow** and **Grey** are the skills where the recipe changes colour. A **New** or **Changed** tag shows a recipe that is new or changed from Classic Era.
